words.force: Force 1 to 5: a realm's army. It sets the tier of its fights, and its goal roll is +1 against a weaker realm, −1 against a stronger one.
words.standing: Standing: how a realm treats the tower, from −2 (enemy: refuses Contact) through 0 (neutral) to +2 (ally: a mark a month on the tower's goal). It moves only by deeds.
words.clock: A clock: a goal's marks out of its size. Each month a realm rolls a d6 for its goal: a 1 loses a mark, 3 to 5 add one, 6 adds two; a full clock fires the goal.
words.hold: Hold: the tower's three boxes. A realm's break-the-tower goal that fires takes one box and half the tower's gold; at 0 boxes it takes a hex instead. Mend a box for 200 GP.
words.renown: Renown: the tower's hexes beyond its own, plus its allies, plus 2 for each ruler toppled. It is read off the map, never bought.
words.tier: The tower's tier, by Renown: Hermit (0), Lord of the hex (2), Warden of the marches (5), A power in the land (9), Master of the twenty hexes (14). Each brings a power.
words.site: A site is a realm's seat, garrison, works or walls in a hex: the thing Morten can strike. It never moves and never attacks.
words.level: Level N: floor N lies under it, its wanderers are level-N trouble, and it pays N×10 GP a month.
words.seat: The hex the ruler sits in. Its court is the realm's hardest fight; a Strike there costs 2 standing.
words.ally: An ally is a realm at standing +2: the tower's ally goal done for it, or a ruler the tower put on the throne.

goalWords.topple: the dissident takes the throne as a good ruler and an ally; Renown +2
